div.div: The adaptation step in Kohonen’s model. The input value v selects a center s in whose neighborhood all neurons shift their weight vectors ws towards the input v. The magnitude of the shift decreases as the distance of a unit from the center s increases. In the figure, this magnitude is indicated by different sizes and gray values. The shift of weights is only depicted, though, for unit s.
